articles.summary: Today, Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII) announced it is donating nearly $125,000 to 13 off-road and snowmobile clubs and organizations across the United States and Canada through its TRAILS GRANTS program . Together with grants awarded to 14 organizations this spring , Polaris has given more than $250,000 through the program in 2026. "Strong riding communities depend on the people who put in the work to keep trails safe, accessible and ready to ride," said Mike Speetzen, CEO of Polaris. "For two decades, Polaris has been proud to stand alongside these volunteers and organizations, caring for the places riders love today while helping preserve access for generations to come." For two decades, the grants have supported locally led projects focused on trail development and maintenance, rider safety and education, and protecting access to outdoor recreation. articles.title: POLARIS MARKS THE CLOSE OF 20TH ANNIVERSARY YEAR OF TRAILS GRANTS WITH MORE THAN $250,000 IN 2026 GIVING
